def: properly, redundant; hence, over and above, as adjective, noun, adverb or conjunction

words.word: and why was i then more
and by it there is profit

occurrences.text: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.
words: and why was I then more

occurrences.text: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?
Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.
words: and by it there is profit

occurrences.text: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?
And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.
